        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (_teamMembers[i] == member) {

        _teamMemberExists[member] = false;
        delete _teamShare[member];

            _teamMembers.push(member);
        }

    function createBoxMould(
        uint128 price,
        uint128 maxPerBuy,
        uint256 maxSupply,
        address[] calldata artists,
        uint256[] calldata artistShares,
        string calldata data0,
        string calldata data1,
        string calldata data2,
        string calldata data3,
        string calldata data4
    ) external onlyOwner {
        require(artists.length == artistShares.length, "NFTBoxes: arrays are not of same");
        uint256 sum;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < artistShares.length; i++) {
            sum += artistShares[i];
        }
        require(sum + _secondaryFeeBps <= TOTAL_SHARES, "NFTBoxes: shares do not add up to 1000");

        uint256 mouldId = ++_boxMouldCount;
        BoxMould storage m = _moulds[mouldId];
        m.exists = true;
        m.price = price;
        m.maxPerBuy = maxPerBuy;
        m.maxSupply = maxSupply;
        m.data0 = data0;
        m.data1 = data1;
        m.data2 = data2;
        m.data3 = data3;
        m.data4 = data4;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < artists.length; i++) {
            m.artists.push(artists[i]);
            m.artistShares.push(artistShares[i]);
        }

        emit BoxMouldCreated(mouldId);
    }

    function addArtists(uint256 mouldId, address artist, uint256 share) external onlyOwner {
        require(artist != address(0), "ERC721: transfer to the zero address");
        BoxMould storage m = _moulds[mouldId];
        require(m.exists, "NFTBoxes: Mould ID does not exist");

        m.artists.push(artist);
        m.artistShares.push(share);

        uint256 sum;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < m.artistShares.length; i++) {
            sum += m.artistShares[i];
        }
        require(sum + _secondaryFeeBps <= TOTAL_SHARES, "NFTBoxes: shares do not add up to 1000");
    }

    function removeArtist(uint256 mouldId, address artist) external onlyOwner {
        BoxMould storage m = _moulds[mouldId];
        require(m.exists, "NFTBoxes: Mould ID does not exist");
        uint256 len = m.artists.length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (m.artists[i] == artist) {
                m.artists[i] = m.artists[len - 1];
                m.artistShares[i] = m.artistShares[len - 1];
                m.artists.pop();
                m.artistShares.pop();
                return;
            }
        }
        revert("NFTBoxes: Not authorised to exec");
    }

    function getArtistRoyalties(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address[] memory recipients, uint256[] memory bps) {

        (recipients, bps) = _royaltiesForMould(_boxesData[tokenId].mouldId);
    }

    function buyManyBoxes(uint256 mouldId, uint128 amount) external payable {
        BoxMould storage m = _moulds[mouldId];
        require(m.exists, "NFTBoxes: Mould ID does not exist");
        require(amount > 0, "NFTBoxes: Cannot buy this many boxes");
        require(uint256(amount) <= 1000, "NFTBoxes: Cannot buy this many boxes");
        if (m.maxPerBuy != 0) {
            require(amount <= m.maxPerBuy, "NFTBoxes: Cannot buy this many boxes");
        }
        require(m.sold + uint256(amount) <= m.maxSupply, "NFTBoxes: Cannot buy this many boxes");

        uint256 totalPrice = uint256(m.price) * uint256(amount);
        require(msg.value == totalPrice, "NFTBoxes: Wrong total price.");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < uint256(amount); i++) {
            uint256 tokenId = ++_nextTokenId;
            _mint(msg.sender, tokenId);
            _boxesData[tokenId] = BoxData({mouldId: mouldId, paidPrice: uint256(m.price), locked: false, distributed: false});
            if (bytes(m.data0).length != 0) {
                _tokenURIs[tokenId] = m.data0;
            }
            m.sold += 1;
        }

        emit BoxBought(mouldId, uint256(amount), totalPrice);

        _boxesData[tokenId].locked = true;

    function distributeShares(uint256 tokenId) external {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        bool allowed = _isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId) || _authorisedCallers[msg.sender] || msg.sender == _owner;
        require(allowed, "NFTBoxes: Not authorised to exec");

        BoxData storage b = _boxesData[tokenId];
        require(b.locked, "NTFBoxes: Box is still live, cannot distribute shares");

        b.distributed = true;
        _payoutForToken(tokenId);

            _requireMinted(tokenIds[i]);
            require(_boxesData[tokenIds[i]].mouldId == mouldId, "NFTBoxes: Mould ID does not exist");

            if (_vendingMachine.code.length > 0) {
                for (uint256 j = 0; j < recipients[i].length; j++) {

        emit BatchDeployed(mouldId, tokenIds.length);

        BoxData storage b = _boxesData[tokenId];

        meta.tokenId = tokenId;
        meta.mouldId = b.mouldId;

        meta.locked = b.locked;
        meta.distributed = b.distributed;

    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {

    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        address tokenOwner = ownerOf(tokenId);

        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);

    function _payoutForToken(uint256 tokenId) internal {
        BoxData storage b = _boxesData[tokenId];
        uint256 gross = b.paidPrice;
        if (gross == 0) {
            gross = uint256(_moulds[b.mouldId].price);
        }

        require(address(this).balance >= gross, "NFTBoxes: Wrong total price.");

        (address[] memory recipients, uint256[] memory bps) = _royaltiesForMould(b.mouldId);

        uint256 sent;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            if (recipients[i] == address(0) || bps[i] == 0) continue;
            uint256 amount = (gross * bps[i]) / TOTAL_SHARES;
            if (amount == 0) continue;
            sent += amount;
            _sendValue(payable(recipients[i]), amount);
        }

        if (gross > sent && _teamAddress != address(0)) {
            _sendValue(payable(_teamAddress), gross - sent);
        }
    }

        (bool ok, ) = to.call{value: value}("");
        require(ok, "Address: call to non-contract");

        BoxMould storage m = _moulds[mouldId];
        require(m.exists, "NFTBoxes: Mould ID does not exist");

        recipients = new address[](m.artists.length + 1);
        bps = new uint256[](m.artistShares.length + 1);

        recipients[0] = _teamAddress;
        bps[0] = _secondaryFeeBps;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < m.artists.length; i++) {
            recipients[i + 1] = m.artists[i];
            bps[i + 1] = m.artistShares[i];
        }

        out.exists = m.exists;
        out.feeA = m.feeA;
        out.feeB = m.feeB;
        out.price = m.price;
        out.maxPerBuy = m.maxPerBuy;
        out.maxSupply = m.maxSupply;
        out.sold = m.sold;
        out.artists = _copyAddresses(m.artists);
        out.artistShares = _copyUints(m.artistShares);
        out.data0 = m.data0;
        out.data1 = m.data1;
        out.data2 = m.data2;
        out.data3 = m.data3;
        out.data4 = m.data4;
    }

    function _copyAddresses(address[] storage src) internal view returns (address[] memory dst) {
        dst = new address[](src.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
            dst[i] = src[i];
        }
    }

    function _copyUints(uint256[] storage src) internal view returns (uint256[] memory dst) {
        dst = new uint256[](src.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
            dst[i] = src[i];
        }
    }

    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _owners[tokenId] != address(0);
    }

    function _requireMinted(uint256 tokenId) internal view {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: owner query for nonexistent token");
    }

    function _approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;
        emit Approval(ownerOf(tokenId), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        address tokenOwner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        return (spender == tokenOwner || isApprovedForAll(tokenOwner, spender) || _tokenApprovals[tokenId] == spender);
    }

    function _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = _ownedTokens[to].length;
        _ownedTokens[to].push(tokenId);
    }

    function _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(address from, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = _ownedTokens[from].length - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];

        if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) {
            uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
            _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
            _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        }

        _ownedTokens[from].pop();
        delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
    }

    function _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = _allTokens.length;
        _allTokens.push(tokenId);
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) private returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length == 0) return true;

        try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
            return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
        } catch (bytes memory reason) {
            if (reason.length == 0) {
                revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
            }
            assembly {
                revert(add(reason, 32), mload(reason))
            }
        }
    }

    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory str) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        uint256 i = digits;
        temp = value;
        while (temp != 0) {
            i--;
            buffer[i] = bytes1(uint8(48 + (temp % 10)));
            temp /= 10;
        }
        str = string(buffer);
    }
